name: SI 32 (Israel)
description: Israeli household plug and socket-outlet: three pins in a Y-shaped triangle with the earth pin below line and neutral. Flat pins until 1989, round pins since; sockets made since 1989 accept both and also take the Europlug.

variants.name: SI 32 plug (round pins)
mechanicalNotes: Since 1989: round pins 4.5 mm in diameter and 19 mm long; before 1989: flat pins in the same positions.
Line and neutral 19 mm apart; earth pin offset 9.5 mm from the line joining them.

matesWith.note: Round-pin plugs need a socket made since 1989.

variants.name: SI 32 socket-outlet
variants.keying: Seen from the front with the earth hole at the bottom: neutral on the left, line on the right.
mechanicalNotes: Sockets made since 1989 accept both flat-pin and round-pin plugs.
